description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipSearchFilterParams class used for filtering employee membership search results in the HRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and manages the employee number parameter with getter and setter methods. It also specifies allowed sort fields.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying search filters related to employee memberships, including employee number and sort options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter object and sets the default sort field to 'm.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter as an integer or null.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter; accepts an integer or null.
